meta.title: Personalised Tutoring for SPM & IGCSE
meta.description: Personalised one-to-one, small-group and online tutoring for secondary students (13+) — SPM and IGCSE exam preparation with Teacher Thomas.

hero.lede: One-to-one, small-group and online tuition for secondary students aged 13 and above. SPM and IGCSE exam preparation that builds confidence and consistent results.

ways.title: Three ways to learn.
ways.oneBody: Full attention on one student — lessons paced exactly to how they learn.
ways.groupBody: Learn alongside a few peers — collaborative, focused and more affordable.
ways.onlineBody: Live lessons from anywhere, with the same structure and feedback as in person.

subjects.intro: From Form 1 foundations to SPM and IGCSE — structured lessons that build understanding step by step.
subjects.lowerBody: Strong foundations across core subjects before the SPM years.
subjects.upperBody: Focused SPM preparation with exam technique and consistent practice.
subjects.igcseBody: Concept-first lessons aligned to the IGCSE syllabus and assessment.

trial.title: Book a 30-minute trial class.
trial.body: See how lessons work with a free, no-obligation 30-minute trial. Message on WhatsApp with your child's level and subjects, and we'll arrange a time.

schedule.intro: Typical weekly availability across formats. Message on WhatsApp to confirm a slot and current fees.
schedule.note: Fees depend on subject, level and format — message on WhatsApp for current pricing.

faq.q1: Which levels and exams do you teach?
faq.a1: Lower secondary (Form 1–3), upper secondary (Form 4–5 / SPM), and IGCSE Chemistry and Physics. Message your child's level and I'll tell you honestly if I'm the right fit.
faq.q2: What teaching formats do you offer?
faq.a2: One-to-one, small-group and online tuition. We'll choose whichever suits your child's needs and schedule.
faq.q3: What happens in the 30-minute trial class?
faq.a3: A short, no-obligation session to understand your child's level and goals, and to see how lessons work before you commit.
faq.q4: What languages do you teach in?
faq.a4: Lessons can be in English, Bahasa Melayu or Mandarin, matched to what the student is most comfortable with.
faq.a5: Fees depend on subject, level and format. Message on WhatsApp for current pricing — no obligation.
faq.a6: Send a WhatsApp message with the student's level and subjects, and we'll arrange your trial class.

about.body1: Teacher Thomas has tutored Malaysian secondary students since 2014, helping them move from confusion to confidence across the sciences, mathematics and languages.
about.body2: The approach is simple — understanding first, then exam technique. Lessons are personalised, patient and student-centred, so progress is steady and results follow.
about.note: Full qualifications and teaching profile coming soon.

contact.intro: Message on WhatsApp or follow along on Instagram. No forms, no fuss — just a quick chat about what your child needs.
